bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder September 23, 2017

Come learn about artist trading cards and drawing from the inside out at a free Meet the Artists demo on Saturday, September 30 from 2 to 4 PM at the Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists.

Artist Anne Briggs will discuss and demonstrate artist trading cards that anyone can create in all different media and display or mail with a note. Each participant will receive at least one trading card with frame and envelope. Artist Yvette Stenzel will demonstrate a technique of “drawing from the inside out”, and both artists will show some creative ways to transform those paintings you were about to throw out.

Exhibiting original artwork by 24 local artists, The Art Gallery of The Guild of Harwich Artists, 551 Main Street (Route 28), Harwich Port, is open 7-days a week. Free public parking located across the street at the Tourist Information Center of the Harwich Chamber of Commerce.

The event is held at the Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists 551 Main St. (Rte.28) in Harwich Port (508-432-1012). Parking is available across the street at the Information Center.
